title: 第17章 慕容第18章 小子夜长大了
content_zh:
;;
大商都城，望湘楼。
二楼，两位女子坐在窗边的桌前，窗外，便是大商都城繁华的景象。
两人的容貌如此的出众，不禁让人频频侧目。
“李姐姐，请。”
慕容开口，以茶代酒相敬眼前女子，微笑道。
“多谢公主殿下。”
李幼薇同样举杯，旋即轻轻抿了一口。
“听说，李姐姐是和我三皇兄一起来的都城，路上，可遇到什么麻烦？”慕容轻声道。
“没有。”
李幼薇轻轻摇头，道，“多亏了三殿下的照顾，一路上还算顺利。”
“那便好。”
慕容微笑道，“对于李姐姐的声名，慕容慕名许久，得知姐姐来了都城，便迫不及待一见，还望李姐姐原谅慕容的唐突。”
“公主殿下客气，能得公主殿下召见，是幼薇的荣幸。”李幼薇轻声说道。
慕容闻言，轻轻一笑，道，“李姐姐，我们就不要再说这些客套话了，不知李姐姐此来都城，有何打算，不如来我的公主府住上几日，我在宫外的府邸，已经许久没有住过，李姐姐若能来，我也好借此机会向母后请求，去宫外住上几日。”
“多谢公主殿下的邀请，只是，幼微此来都城，是来商议合作之事，行程和住处都已安排好，只能和公主殿下说抱歉了。”李幼薇神色平和说道。
“这样啊，那真是可惜。”
慕容面露遗憾之色，不过，很快恢复如初，笑道，“算了，反正李姐姐就在这都城中，慕容要想见姐姐，有的是机会。”
“嗯。”
李幼薇轻轻点头，没有多说什么。

“对了，李姐姐方才说的合作之事，不知可否有意中的人选，慕容倒是有几家不错的人选，可以向李姐姐引荐。”
慕容半客套，半真诚的说道。
“在渝州城时，三殿下给李家提起过三家，长孙家，商盟，还有尹氏钱庄，三殿下说会帮忙引荐，只是，还没能得见。”李幼薇说道。
“商盟，尹氏钱庄。”
慕容轻声呢喃了一句，美丽的眸子中道道流光闪过。
三皇兄还真会引荐，这两家虽然都和朝廷有关系，但是，同样和三皇兄也牵扯甚深。
三家人选，两家都是三皇兄的势力，目的不言而喻。
看来，这次三皇兄虽然完成了父皇交代的任务，暗地里却也藏了不少私心。
“既然三皇兄答应要为姐姐引荐，慕容就不多事了。”
慕容张了张嘴，似乎想要说什么，又咽了下去。
李幼薇见状，很是配合地问道，“公主殿下，幼微初来都城，对于都城很多事并不熟悉，还望公主殿下能够提点一二。”
“确实有几句话想要和姐姐说。”
慕容想了想，神色真诚道，“都城势力错综复杂，虽然大家都是在为朝廷效力，但是，暗地里也有很多人包藏祸心，姐姐在寻找合作人选时，还是要小心一些为好。”
“公主殿下可否明示。”李幼薇凝声道。
“隔墙有耳，有些话，我也不能说的太明白。”
慕容看了看热闹的二楼，道，“姐姐小心一些便是，当然，姐姐若是信得过，不妨在合作时多考虑一下长孙家，那是我母后的家族，我还是能为姐姐说上几句话的。”
content_en:

Wangxiang Tower, the great commercial capital.
On the second floor, two women were sitting at the table by the window. Outside the window, they could see the bustling scene of the big commercial city.
The appearance of the two people is so outstanding that people can't help but look at them frequently.
"Sister Li, please."
Murong opened his mouth, offered tea instead of wine to the woman in front of him, and smiled.
"Thank you, Your Highness Princess."
Li Youwei also raised her glass and took a sip.
"I heard that Sister Li came to the capital with my Third Emperor Brother. Did she encounter any trouble on the way?" Murong said softly.
"No."
Li Youwei shook her head gently and said, "Thanks to the care of His Highness, the trip went smoothly."
"That's good."
Murong smiled and said, "Murong has been admiring Sister Li's reputation for a long time. When he learned that sister had come to the capital, he couldn't wait to see her. He also hoped that Sister Li would forgive Murong's abruptness."
"Your Highness the Princess, you are so polite. It is an honor for Youwei to be summoned by Your Highness the Princess." Li Youwei said softly.
Hearing this, Murong smiled softly and said, "Sister Li, let's not say these polite words anymore. I don't know what sister Li's plans are for coming to the capital. Why don't you come and stay in my princess's mansion for a few days. I haven't lived in a mansion outside the palace for a long time. If sister Li can come, I can also take this opportunity to ask my mother to live outside the palace for a few days."
"Thank you for the invitation from Her Highness the Princess. However, Youwei came to the capital here to discuss cooperation. The itinerary and accommodation have been arranged. I can only say sorry to Her Highness the Princess." Li Youwei said calmly.
"Well, that's a pity."
Murong had a look of regret on his face, but he quickly recovered and said with a smile, "Forget it, Sister Li is in the capital anyway. If Murong wants to see her, there are plenty of opportunities."
"Yeah."
Li Youwei nodded lightly and said nothing more.
"By the way, for the cooperation that Sister Li just mentioned, I wonder if there are any suitable candidates. Murong does have a few good candidates that he can recommend to Sister Li."
Murong said half politely, half sincerely.
"When we were in Yuzhou City, His Highness the Third Highness mentioned three families to the Li family: the Changsun Family, the Merchant Alliance, and the Yin Family Bank. The Third Highness said he would help introduce them, but we haven't been able to meet them yet," Li Youwei said.
"Business Alliance, Yin's Bank."
Murong murmured softly, and streams of light flashed in his beautiful eyes.
The Third Emperor Brother is really good at making recommendations. Although these two families are related to the imperial court, they are also deeply involved with the Third Emperor Brother.
The three families were selected, and both families were members of the Three Emperors Brothers. Their purpose was self-evident.
It seems that although the Third Emperor Brother has completed the task assigned by his father this time, he also has a lot of selfish intentions secretly.
"Since Brother Three Emperors has promised to introduce me to my sister, Murong won't have to worry about anything."
Murong opened his mouth, as if he wanted to say something, and then swallowed.
Seeing this, Li Youwei asked very cooperatively, "Your Highness Princess, Youwei is new to the capital and is not familiar with many things in the capital. I hope your Highness the Princess can give you some advice."
"I do have a few things I want to say to my sister."
Murong thought for a while and said with a sincere expression, "The forces in the capital are complex. Although everyone is working for the imperial court, there are many people secretly harboring evil intentions. Sister, it is better to be careful when looking for partners."
"Your Highness, can you make it clear?" Li Youwei said in a serious voice.
"Walls have ears, and there are some words I can't explain very clearly."
Murong looked at the bustling second floor and said, "Sister, just be careful. Of course, if you are trustworthy, you might as well consider the eldest grandson's family when working together. That is my mother's family. I can still say a few words for my sister."
